summary: 1934 metal fire tower in Tar Hollow State Forest, Ross County, Ohio; restored by the state, and a 2026 trail guide says visitors can climb it.

facts.design: 73-foot McClintock-Marshall metal tower with 7 by 7 foot metal cab

access.note: A 2026 trail guide says visitors can climb the tower. The state's own page could not be read, so check with the park before a visit.

visit.trail_note: Reached from South Ridge Road in Tar Hollow State Park; the 2010 visit report gives directions from South Ridge Road (Forest Road 3).

events.note: Built 1934 per the marker, the register's build field and the record. The register's description says constructed in 1933.
An October 1934 Chillicothe Gazette item says George Strausbaugh of the Tucson community will be towerman

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's description says constructed in 1933, but its build field, the state marker and the record say 1934. A January 1934 item calls the tower just completed, which fits either year. The story uses 1934 and reports the 1933 wording.

sources.title: Brush Ridge Fire Tower Historical Marker
Tar Hollow State Park: Fire Tower Views and Remote Ridge Trails

notes_for_editor: The ODNR page for this tower returned 404 in the crawl, so current status rests on a 2026 trail guide and a 2010 register visit report. Build year is disputed within the register (1933 description, 1934 field). A March 1934 item about a tower on Piney Creek is a different tower and is not used. The record says steel; the register text read says metal, so the material field should be checked against the register's own field. The Waymarking page could not be read.
